title: Kids Wildlife Talk
summary: A family-friendly wildlife talk for curious kids. Don't miss out!
why_we_like_it: Good mix of learning and excitement without feeling too formal.
image_alt: Kids watching a wildlife talk

title: Free Library Storytime
summary: Songs, stories and a gentle indoor outing for little kids.
why_we_like_it: Easy, free and perfect for a low-energy morning.
image_alt: Storytime at a library

title: 4 ASD Kids Art Exhibition and Auction
summary: A free exhibition of original work by leading Australian children's book illustrators, with each piece auctioned to support local charity 4ASDKids.
why_we_like_it: It is an easy, thoughtful outing for young artists and book-loving families, with a genuinely worthwhile local cause behind it.
image_alt: Colourful framed children's book illustrations displayed at Gallery 8

title: Mystical Fairy Doors
address: Cnr Bermuda and Markeri Streets, Mermaid Waters QLD 4218
summary: Follow a centre map to find seven tiny fairy doors, scan their QR codes and discover who lives behind each one. Kids who identify all seven fairies can claim a small fairy door to paint at home, while stocks last.
why_we_like_it: It turns an ordinary shopping-centre visit into a simple little treasure hunt without costing anything.
image_alt: A child discovering a tiny fairy door hidden inside Q Super Centre

title: Rainbow Families Nerang Playgroup
venue: The Benevolent Society Nerang Early Years Centre
summary: A welcoming weekly playgroup for LGBTQIA+ families, with free play, activities, stories, music and time for parents and carers to connect.
why_we_like_it: A warm, low-pressure local session where little kids can play and families can build real community.
image_alt: Young children playing together at the Rainbow Families Nerang Playgroup

title: Fairy Rhyme Time
address: Cnr Guineas Creek Road and KP McGrath Drive, Elanora QLD 4221
summary: Fairy Ani leads a playful session of songs, puppets, dancing, instruments, storytelling and gentle sensory play for young children.
why_we_like_it: It is a polished little midweek activity that feels magical to toddlers while still being easy for parents.
image_alt: Fairy Ani leading music and movement activities for young children at The Pines Elanora

title: Messy Play: Wheels and Transport
address: 950 Beaudesert Nerang Road, Mount Nathan QLD 4211
summary: A child-led morning of taste-safe sensory stations themed around wheels and transport, set beside the Coomera River for children from six months to five years.
why_we_like_it: The setting and carefully staged messy play make this more memorable than the usual indoor toddler session.
image_alt: A toddler exploring a taste-safe messy play station beside the Coomera River

title: Surfers Paradise Beachfront Markets
summary: A twilight beachfront market with more than 100 stalls, local makers, live music, sweet treats and an easy walk along the Surfers Paradise foreshore. This week's sessions run Wednesday, Friday and Saturday.
why_we_like_it: It is flexible, free to browse and easy to pair with dinner or a quick play on the beach.
image_alt: Families browsing market stalls along the Surfers Paradise beachfront at dusk

title: Gold Coast Show
price: Free entry; rides, showbags and food extra
summary: The Gold Coast's huge waterfront show returns with rides, showbags, baby animals, camel rides, Dock Dogs, duck racing, reptiles, equestrian events, woodchop, food and fireworks at 6:45pm each night.
why_we_like_it: This is the week's undeniable headline family event, with enough free entertainment to build a full day around.
image_alt: Families enjoying rides, animals and entertainment at the Gold Coast Show in Broadwater Parklands

title: Circus Rio: Coomera
price: Ticketed; prices vary by session and seating
summary: Circus Rio brings aerial silks, cloudswing, juggling, Cyr wheel, hand balancing, illusion and comedy to Westfield Coomera, with several sessions across its Gold Coast run.
why_we_like_it: It is a proper big-top spectacle with enough variety to hold both younger kids and older siblings.
image_alt: A Circus Rio aerial performer high above the big-top ring in Coomera

title: Dreamworld Night Market
price: Free for kids under 13 and passholders; $2 otherwise
summary: Street food, live music, family entertainment and selected after-dark rides inside Dreamworld, without needing a daytime theme-park ticket. This week's sessions run Friday and Saturday.
why_we_like_it: The tiny entry price makes it an unusually easy way to give kids a taste of Dreamworld after dark.
image_alt: Families eating street food under lights at Dreamworld Night Market

title: Burleigh Market
address: 1750 Gold Coast Highway, Burleigh Heads QLD 4220
summary: A lively Saturday farmers and community market with fresh produce, bakery treats, global food, plants, crafts, collectibles and local live music.
why_we_like_it: It is relaxed, useful and child-friendly, especially if you want breakfast and an easy wander rather than a major event.
image_alt: Families browsing fresh produce and craft stalls at Burleigh Market

title: Saturday Kids Club
address: 149 West Burleigh Road, Burleigh Heads QLD 4220
summary: A free drop-in craft session where kids can make rotating projects such as decorated bags, pencil cases, plaster animals, keyrings and bookmarks.
why_we_like_it: It is a handy small event for filling an hour, especially if the weather turns or you are already near Burleigh.
image_alt: Children making colourful craft projects at Stockland Burleigh Heads

title: Dreamworld Children's Book Weekend
price: Kids under 13 in Book Week costume free; accompanying guests $50 each
summary: Book Week costumes get another outing at Dreamworld, with free entry for costumed children under 13, a 1:30pm costume competition, character appearances and face painting across the weekend.
why_we_like_it: It turns the effort of making a costume into a full theme-park day and gives imaginative kids a moment in the spotlight.
image_alt: Children in Book Week costumes meeting Dreamworld characters on Main Street

title: Gold Coast Titans v Rabbitohs and NRLW v Raiders
summary: A rugby league double-header at Cbus Super Stadium, beginning with the Titans against the Raiders in the NRLW before the men's side faces South Sydney, plus entertainment and giveaways.
why_we_like_it: Two matches on one ticket makes this a strong first live-sport outing for kids who can handle a loud stadium.
image_alt: A family cheering for the Gold Coast Titans inside Cbus Super Stadium

title: Dreamworld Fun Run
summary: Run, jog or walk through Dreamworld and WhiteWater World on a 5km course or 2km Junior Dash, with colour zones, entertainment, fundraising and a finisher medal.
why_we_like_it: Running through a closed theme park is genuinely different and the short junior option keeps it accessible for families.
image_alt: Children and parents running through a colourful zone inside Dreamworld

title: Go Gold Coast Fitness Festival
summary: A free morning of community fitness by the beach, with a 5km run, Pilates rave, yoga, circuit training, 80s aerobics, breathwork, line dancing, wellness stalls and a dedicated kids zone.
why_we_like_it: Parents can join a proper class while the family atmosphere and kids zone stop it feeling like an adults-only fitness expo.
image_alt: Families moving and dancing together at the Go Gold Coast Fitness Festival in Coolangatta

title: The Coastal Markets: Burleigh Heads
summary: Hundreds of handmade, artisan and coastal lifestyle stalls fill Justins Park for this large last-Sunday market beside Burleigh Beach.
why_we_like_it: The beachfront setting gives restless kids room to move and makes it easy to turn a market browse into a fuller morning out.
image_alt: Families browsing artisan stalls beneath trees at Justins Park in Burleigh Heads

title: Fiji Untold by VOU
summary: A high-energy one-hour theatre work bringing Fijian myths to life through contemporary choreography, live drumming, circus, immersive projections and athletic physical performance.
why_we_like_it: It is culturally rich and visually big, making it a strong theatre choice for older kids who find traditional stage shows too quiet.
image_alt: VOU dancers performing Fiji Untold with dramatic lighting and live drumming at HOTA

title: National All Schools Netball Challenge
summary: Secondary school teams from around Australia compete across junior, intermediate and senior divisions in a fast-paced national netball tournament leading into finals.
why_we_like_it: Young netball players can watch high-level school competition for free and see a clear pathway beyond their local club.
image_alt: Secondary school netball teams competing at Coomera Indoor Sports Centre

title: Flicks and Fireworks: GOAT
address: In front of Cavill Avenue, Surfers Paradise QLD 4217
summary: Bring a blanket for a free screening of GOAT on the sand at Surfers Paradise, with the movie pausing for an 8pm fireworks display over the ocean before continuing.
why_we_like_it: A beach movie and fireworks in the same night is a genuinely memorable family outing that costs nothing.
image_alt: Families watching the movie GOAT on Surfers Paradise Beach as fireworks light the ocean
